pictures: Title strip: kicker 'LCA Newsletter · The page', heading 'Sending later', the line 'Pick a day and time, and change it any time before it sends.', a 'Built from Newsletter-Page-4, the page as approved, and its own pieces · Replaces nothing on it' line and the Sample data badge. Under it, 'Notes on this board' with five gold numbered badges keyed to five gold badges set in the left margin beside each picture, outside the page frames. No badge sits on a control.

1 'After pressing the small arrow on Send'. The grey line says 'Two ways to send: now, or on a day and time you pick.' The picture is the full 1200-wide bar from the page board, copied unchanged: More options, 1 Pick a template to start from, 2 Send a test to me, 3 Send to 167 people. The bottom of the desk shows above it, cut off with a fade. The gold arrow is drawn pressed: a darker gold, an up chevron and aria-expanded true. A menu opens upward in the page's card (white, 1px #cfcec6 border, 14px radius, the chooser's shadow) with the From list's 56px rows. The rows are 'Send now' with a paper-plane icon and 'Send later' with a clock icon. Every word is as the spec gives it.

2 'After choosing Send later'. The grey line says 'The day from the calendar, the time from the list, then Schedule it.' The panel is titled 'Send later' and sits over the page, above step 3, in the same card. Its contents: the 'Day' field (the page's own field with a grey label cell) showing 'Tue, Dec 1, 2026' with a calendar icon and the opened 2px navy border; a calendar for December 2026 with 44px back and forward buttons and the weekday letters S M T W T F S (each with its full name as a title); 44px day buttons with the 1st chosen in navy fill, white bold type and aria-pressed; the 'Time' field showing '9:00 AM' with 'Central time' beside it; and the buttons 'Schedule it' (gold, with a clock icon) and 'Not now' (white with a navy border). There is no close X and no explaining sentence. One change from the spec: no day is drawn as past. The board's 'now' is Mon, Nov 23, 2026, so no December 2026 day is in the past. The two cells before the 1st are left empty. See unresolved.

3 'Once it is scheduled'. The grey line says 'Mon, Nov 23, 2026, 2:15 PM. The letter can still be written on and a test still sent, until it goes.' It shows the whole page at full size (scale 1) in the page board's browser frame. The head line reads 'Newsletter  December 2026 · [clock] Scheduled for Tue, Dec 1, 2026 at 9:00 AM', with the scheduled words in navy at weight 600, then 'Saved automatically at 2:15 PM', all on one line. A quiet green band under the head says '[check] Scheduled. It sends Tue, Dec 1, 2026 at 9:00 AM Central time.', with 'Scheduled.' in bold. Step 3 in the bar is mark 3 and a white button with a 1.5px navy border, 242 x 46 (the same box as Send and its arrow). It holds a clock, the stacked words 'Sends' over 'Tue, Dec 1 at 9:00 AM', a divider and a small arrow. Its accessible name is the full sentence. One change from the spec: the words sit on two lines. On one line, 'Sends Tue, Dec 1 at 9:00 AM' needs about 280px, which would have squeezed the three 36.5px gaps to about 17px. Stacked, it fits Send's exact box, so More options and steps 1 and 2 stay pixel for pixel where the page has them. Steps 1 and 2, More options, the toolbar, the letter and the side column are unchanged.

4 'After pressing the arrow on a scheduled letter'. The grey line says 'Change the day or time, send it now, or do not send it.' The picture is the right 600px of the scheduled bar (mark 2, Send a test to me, mark 3 and the scheduled button, drawn opened with an up arrow). A menu opens upward with three 56px rows, each with an icon: 'Change the day or time', 'Send now' and 'Do not send it'. Under a rule is the quiet line 'Scheduled by Player One on Mon, Nov 23, 2026', on one line. Beside it is 4b 'After choosing Change the day or time', with the grey line 'The same panel as Send later, with the new day and time.' It is the same panel titled 'Change the day or time', showing Day 'Thu, Dec 3, 2026', Time '6:30 PM' with 'Central time', 'Save the new time' (gold) and 'Not now'. Its calendar is drawn closed to keep the picture small.

5 'On a phone'. The side text says 'A phone had no Send before; it now sits at the foot of What members will get.' Two phones in the page board's own phone frame. The first, 'Sending from a phone' (grey line: 'Send and Send later at the foot of the email.'), is the page board's See the email sheet. At its foot is a row with 'Send to 167 people' (gold, 198px) and 'Send later' (white with a navy border and a clock, 133px), both 50px tall, above the page's own 'Back to writing'. The second, 'Once it is scheduled' (grey line: 'When it sends, under the month and at the foot.'), is the page board's phone page. Its head reads 'December 2026', then on its own line '[clock] Scheduled for Tue, Dec 1, 2026 at 9:00 AM', then 'Saved automatically at 2:15 PM'. The foot has a full-width white button with a navy border reading '[clock] Sends Tue, Dec 1 at 9:00 AM' with its arrow (50px), above the page's 'Pick a template' and 'See the email'.

'For the build' sits in a card in the right column of the phone row, the last block on the board, with the spec's eight short lines. The time is Central time, shown in words. A day or time already past cannot be chosen. The people are counted again when it sends. The letter can be changed until it sends, and what goes out is the letter as it stands then. Changing the time, Send now and 'Do not send it' are open to everyone who may send. 'Do not send it' puts the letter back as a draft and deletes nothing. Each of these is written in the activity log with who did it. Only one newsletter can be scheduled or sending at a time.

In picture 3: More options 145 to 315, mark 1 352 to 384, Pick 394 to 715, mark 2 751 to 783, Send a test 793 to 975, mark 3 1011 to 1043, scheduled button 1053 to 1295, 46 tall. result.phone: On the page board, a phone never reaches Send. 'The page' has only Pick a template and See the email at its foot (More options is at the end of the page), and the See the email sheet has only 'Back to writing'. As the spec says for that case, I drew the two buttons at the foot of the See the email sheet: 'Send to 167 people' (gold) with 'Send later' (plain, white with a navy border) beside it, both 50px tall and in full words, above the page's own 'Back to writing'. The scheduled state is drawn on the phone page itself. The head shows 'December 2026', then on its own line the clock and 'Scheduled for Tue, Dec 1, 2026 at 9:00 AM', then 'Saved automatically at 2:15 PM'. At the foot, a full-width 50px button reading 'Sends Tue, Dec 1 at 9:00 AM' with a clock and a small arrow sits above Pick a template and See the email.
unresolved: Past days in the calendar (check 5): on Mon, Nov 23, 2026, the board's 'now' (the day Player One schedules it), no day of December 2026 is in the past. Any change to a letter scheduled for Tue, Dec 1 also comes before that day, so a December calendar can never truthfully show a past day. I left the two cells before the 1st empty rather than draw future days as past. The rule stays in For the build ('A day or time already past cannot be chosen'). If K wants the past-day look shown, it needs a November view or a different 'now'.

Step 3 once scheduled shows its words on two lines ('Sends' over 'Tue, Dec 1 at 9:00 AM'), not one, so it fits Send's exact 242 x 46 box and More options and steps 1 and 2 keep the page's positions and 36.5px gaps (check 3). On one line the button needs about 280px, and the three gaps would shrink to about 17px. Its accessible name, and the phone's button, give the full one-line words.

The board is 4200 tall (content 4165), above the spec's aim of about 2200 to 3400 but within the 5600 limit. Most of the height is picture 3, drawn at full size (about 1200) so the head line and bar read at a glance, and picture 2's calendar panel (690).
Picture 4b draws the Change the day or time panel with its calendar closed, to keep the second picture small. It is otherwise the same panel as picture 2.

The 'Notes on this board' legend and its gold numbered badges are kept outside the pictures (in the left margin), so no explaining words sit beside a control. 'For the build' is the last block on the board, beside the phones, not a full-width block under them, so the phone row has no bare patch over 150px.
